status: approved composite preserved; visible-only extraction; no runtime change
compositing: Start with body RGBA, source-over weapon-visible, then hand-foreground. Identity transforms only. Do not re-register or scale per frame.
mask_semantics: Binary disjoint ownership of original straight-RGBA pixels. Body mask includes the transparent background for exact byte ownership. Source edge pixels retain original color/alpha, including any flattened edge mixture.
limitations: Visible-pixel partition only. Body contains transparent holes where sword and gripping hands were cut out. Hidden body and hidden sword are NOT reconstructed.
Weapon is not a complete independently movable sprite. Repositioning any layer exposes holes and may reveal original edge mixtures.
Manual polygon boundaries are semantic approximations at contact edges; QA images make them reviewable. Pixel equality proves composite preservation, not perfect semantic segmentation.
Scabbard, costume fittings, non-gripping/throwing hands, and unclassified source artifacts remain in body.
Frame 005 has torso-occluded sword sections and separate visible hilt/blade regions. Frame 015 has a top-clipped blade tip.
Angles and palm coordinates are advisory art metadata, not authored physics, hitboxes, events, enemy attachment tracks or runtime sockets.
All approved source defects, including blade-removal edge remnants in some recovery frames, are preserved verbatim.
